At the venue, we were able to experience the story of a woman who runs a photo studio, so in this article we will share with you the experience.

ja.title: 世界的に有名なカンフーパンク：『シャドウブレード ゼロ』体験レポート
ja.summary: 注: この記事は約 13,000 ワードです。プレイヤーのゲーム体験を確実にするため、この記事にはネタバレは含まれません。ただし、一部の写真や文章には、発表内容の解釈や小道具の説明が含まれています。適宜お読みください。剣が光り、竹の葉が落ちた。まだ生死は決まらず、勝敗は決まった。個人的な経験だけを話すと、おそらく『シャドウ ブレード ゼロ』は私にとって近年で最も満足度の高いスタンドアロン アクション格闘技ゲームです。内容が充実していて、リズムがタイトで、システムが奥深く、ゲーム性も多彩……これらの総評に比べて、より直接的な主観的な感想は「楽しい」ということです。クリアまでに40時間近くかかったゲームを1週間クリアした後でも、まだ少しやり残した感があった。未だに「武道」がそのような姿で現れるとは、私には考えられないからです。以前は、武道に対する私の想像力は、風景、宗派、騎士、恨みなどから切り離せないことがよくありました。しかし、『シャドウ ブレード ゼロ』は、荒廃した、ぞっとするような、残酷で、そして少し恐ろしい世界を構築しました。

en.title: Kung Fu Punk, famous all over the world: "Shadow Blade Zero" experience report
en.summary: Note: This article is about 13,000 words. To ensure players’ gaming experience, this article will not contain any spoilers. However, some pictures and texts will cover the interpretation of some announced content and the description of some props. Please read them as appropriate. The sword flashed, and the bamboo leaves fell. Life and death were not yet determined, and the victory or defeat was decided. If I only talk about personal experience, "Shadow Blade Zero" is probably the most satisfying stand-alone action martial arts game for me in recent years. The content is substantial, the rhythm is tight, the system is deep enough, and the gameplay is diverse... Compared to these general comments, my more direct subjective feeling is that it is "enjoyable". Even after completing one week of the game, which took nearly forty hours to complete, I still felt a little unfinished. Because it’s hard for me to imagine that “martial arts” can still appear in such an appearance. In the past, my imagination of martial arts was often inseparable from landscapes, sects, knights, and grudges. However, "Shadow Blade Zero" has constructed a dilapidated, chilling, cruel, and even a bit terrifying world.

ja.title: Touch Le Weird Story: PS5 を修理しました
ja.summary: 変なものが大好きで、くだらない話や幽霊の話、ゲーム関連の新ネタなどを日々語っています。 「親指を4つ上げます」（写真／ロナウド） 先週末、ついに決心してPS5を修理に出しました。なぜ「執拗」と言うかというと、私は非常にボーっとしているタイプのプレイヤーだからです。 Steamdeck で「中国版『アークナイツ ジ エンド』をプレイする方法」をいじるのに 1 ～ 2 時間費やすこともできます。また、PS5 の過熱とシャットダウンの問題を「大した問題ではない!」と思って半年以上先延ばしにすることもできます。今年の初めから、私の PS5 が時々轟音を立て、画面に「PS5 の温度が高すぎます」という警告メッセージが点滅するようになりました。ゲームの最適化の問題だと思い、自然に冷めるのを待ってみようと思い、この状況下で『The Lonely Shadow』、『Marvel's Spider-Man 2』…特に『Marvel's Spider-Man 2』を一通りプレイし、害虫とDNAを除去するために研究室に入りました。

en.title: Touch Le Weird Story: Repaired a PS5
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. "Four thumbs up" (Photo/Ronaldo) Last weekend, I finally made up my mind and took the PS5 for repair. The reason why I say "relentless" is because I am the kind of player who is very dazed. I can spend an hour or two tinkering with "how to play the Chinese version of "Arknights: The End" in the Steamdeck. I can also procrastinate on the problem of PS5 overheating and shutting down for more than half a year, thinking, "It's not a big problem!" Since the beginning of this year, my PS5 will roar and roar from time to time, and then the "PS5 temperature is too high" reminder will flash on the screen. At first, I just thought it was an optimization problem of the game, thinking that I would just wait for it to cool down on its own and wait for a while. Under this situation, I even played through "The Lonely Shadow", "Marvel's Spider-Man 2"...especially "Marvel's Spider-Man 2", and entered the laboratory to eliminate pests and DNA.

items.summary: 要想离开夜之城只有一个办法。被装进裹尸袋。——贝斯·伊西斯 在看完不久前上线的《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》动画后，我的记忆又被带回了四年前看完第一部的那个夏天。当《I Really Want to Stay at Your House》响起来的时候，轻柔的女声唱着“So, get away. Another way”但实际上根本没有another way，有的只是一个呆坐在屏幕前怅然若失的我。当时的我一定想不到，当期盼已久的第二部真的摆在面前，我却丧失了再度打开它的勇气：这真的是《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》吗？ ——请注意，前方包含大量剧透，没看过的观众请速速撤离，这不是演习—— ■ 优点与闪光 本作

ja.title: 「サイバーパンク: エッジウォーカー 2」が祭壇から落ちた

en.title: "Cyberpunk: Edgewalker 2" fell from the altar
en.summary: There is only one way to leave Night City. Put into a body bag. ——Bess Isis After watching the "Cyberpunk: Edgewalker 2" animation that was launched not long ago, my memory was brought back to the summer when I watched the first part four years ago. When "I Really Want to Stay at Your House" played, a soft female voice sang "So, get away. Another way" but in fact there was no other way at all, there was just me sitting in front of the screen feeling lost. I must have never imagined at the time that when the long-awaited second part was actually in front of me, I lost the courage to open it again: Is this really "Cyberpunk: Edgewalker 2"? ——Please note that there are a lot of spoilers ahead. If you haven’t seen it, please evacuate immediately. This is not a drill—— ■ Advantages and highlights of this work

items.summary: 触乐怪话，每天胡侃和游戏有关的屁事、鬼事、新鲜事。 小罗老师……这对吗？（图/小罗） 最近趁着节假日，我跟着朋友去体验了一次恋陪本，拥有了一次新鲜且奇异的体验。 关于恋陪本，我早有耳闻，带我玩的朋友，也是该品类的专家。她的朋友圈总有固定出现的男性面孔。在这些视频里，他们会在小剧场中演一些浪漫的情节，像是对方在她的怀里死去，两人大声呼唤彼此，再依依惜别。当时我一直猜测对方的身份，以为那是她的对象，后来才知道，那是恋陪NPC。 好几次没有约定成行，趁着假期，我们终于能够约在了一起。当天中午，我带着懵懂出发，怀揣“迟到就得发红包”的忐忑提前抵达现场，工作人员问我：“你将饰演哪名角色？”我一问三不知。

ja.summary: 変なものが大好きで、くだらない話や幽霊の話、ゲーム関連の新ネタなどを日々語っています。シャオ・ルオ先生…そうですか？ (写真/Xiao Luo) 最近、休暇中に友達とラブブックを体験しに行き、新鮮で奇妙な経験をしました。恋愛本の話は昔から聞いていましたし、一緒に遊びに連れて行ってくれた友人もこの分野の達人です。彼女の友達にはいつも男性の顔がいます。これらのビデオでは、相手が彼女の腕の中で息を引き取る、二人が大声で呼び合い、そして別れを告げるなど、ロマンチックなシーンを小さな劇場で演じます。その時は彼女のパートナーだと思って相手の正体を推測し続けていました。後で知ったのですが、ロマンティックなNPCでした。何度か行けなかったのですが、連休中にやっと一緒に会う約束をすることができました。その日の昼、何も知らずに出発し、「遅れたら赤い封筒をもらう」と心配しながら早めに現場に到着した。スタッフさんに「どの役をやるの？」と聞かれました。知りませんでした。

en.title: Weird story: Playing with love books, a father comes from the sky
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. Teacher Xiao Luo...is this right? (Photo / Xiao Luo) Recently, during the holidays, I went to experience a love book with my friends, and had a fresh and strange experience. I have long heard about romance books, and the friend who took me to play with them is also an expert in this category. There are always male faces in her circle of friends. In these videos, they will act out some romantic scenes in a small theater, such as the other party dying in her arms, the two calling each other loudly, and then saying goodbye. At that time, I kept guessing about the other party's identity, thinking that it was her partner. Later I found out that it was a romantic NPC. We couldn't make the trip several times, but during the holidays, we were finally able to make an appointment together. At noon that day, I set out ignorantly, and arrived at the scene early with the worry that "if you are late, you will get a red envelope." The staff asked me: "Which role will you play?" I didn't know.

en.title: Chat with Hidetaka Miyazaki and find the soul of the "Souls-like" game
en.summary: Action games have always had a complicated relationship with difficulty. Decades ago, older action games tended to be extremely difficult, but that wasn't always the intention of the designers. The reason why they have a steep difficulty curve and a large number of levels or scenes that require players to trial and error is largely because at that time, the developers who pioneered the action genre tried to test the players' precise operations as much as possible while ensuring fairness. In the early days of the game industry, this was the best practice explored by predecessors. With the rise of cinematic narrative techniques, many action games have lowered their difficulty in order to present fascinating plots so that a wider group of players can experience them easily.
